title: Decide who owns work-type to model: factory table, repo [roles.*.tiers] overlays, or both (wne options a/b/c)
body: wne's notes flagged this conflict to settle before building, and it was not settled: mrn added the factory's RUN_WORKER_MODEL_BY_WORK_TYPE table, while the local path routes classification through dear_tier into the repo's [roles.*.tiers] overlays. Two sources can now name a model for the same work. The options are (a) the factory wins, (b) the repo may override within what the factory serves, or (c) the repo declares work types only. Which one depends on whether enrolled repos really need different models, so it is an operator decision on architecture that outlives this epic.
